national_news.title: PM Modi Interacts with Team India Contingent for WorldSkills Shanghai 2026
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi interacted with Team India representatives following the 48th WorldSkills Competition held in Shanghai, China.
Team India secured the 10th position globally at the competition, winning 6 Silver Medals and 20 Medals for Excellence with its largest-ever contingent of 70 competitors across 63 skills.
The Prime Minister emphasized that practical skills are as vital as academic degrees and reiterated the government's focus on skill development institutions alongside IITs and IIMs.

national_news.title: Andhra Pradesh Artifacts Featured in PM Mementos E-Auction for Namami Gange
bullets: Eighteen mementos showcasing Andhra Pradesh's cultural heritage and traditional crafts are part of the ongoing PM Mementos public e-auction.
Featured items include traditional Kondapalli woodcraft, Kalamkari textile art, and the Stree Shakti Pratibha Award-2025 commemorative memento.
All proceeds from the public auction on pmmementos.gov.in, open until October 31, 2026, will directly support the Namami Gange Programme for River Ganga conservation.

national_news.title: INS Kulish Arrives in Singapore as Part of Eastern Fleet Deployment
bullets: Indian Naval Ship (INS) Kulish arrived at Tuas Terminal in Singapore for an operational turnaround (OTR) as part of the Indian Navy's ongoing Eastern Fleet Operational Deployment.

Prior to the visit, INS Kulish along with stealth frigate INS Sahyadri participated in the 23rd ASEAN Defence Ministers' Meeting-Plus (ADMM-Plus) Experts' Working Group on Maritime Security Joint Cooperative Activity at Subic Bay, Philippines.
The deployment aligns with India's 'Act East Policy' and the vision of MAHASAGAR (Mutual and Holistic Advancement for Security and Growth Across Regions) to foster regional maritime cooperation.

national_news.title: Digital Trust and ABHA IDs in India's Healthcare System
bullets: As of September 17, 2026, India recorded 97.61 crore ABHA IDs in operation with 119.95 crore health records linked to them.
Over 50 crore teleconsultations have been conducted in the country, including services through the government's e-Sanjeevani platform.
The article highlights the necessity of robust digital trust and continuous identity verification frameworks in healthcare, referencing past CAG audit findings on Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY.

national_news.title: Government Caps Trade Margins on Non-Scheduled Anti-Cancer Drugs at 30%
bullets: The Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers approved a 30% Maximum Retail Price (MRP) cap on trade margins for non-scheduled anti-cancer drugs.
The National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority (NPPA) will issue the notification following the finalization of the drug list by a DGHS expert committee.
The decision is expected to reduce non-scheduled anti-cancer medicine prices by up to 70% and save patients approximately ₹2,500 crore annually.

national_news.title: PM Modi Inaugurates 10th India Mobile Congress in New Delhi
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the 10th edition of the India Mobile Congress (IMC) at Yashobhoomi, New Delhi, with the theme 'Scale Without Boundaries'.
Key statistics highlighted include 5G connectivity reaching every district across India through more than 5,50,000 base stations.
Union Communications Minister Jyotiraditya Scindia highlighted that data costs dropped from ₹268 per GB in 2014 to around ₹8 per GB today.

national_news.title: Union Finance Minister Chairs 57th GST Council Meeting in New Delhi
bullets: Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman chaired the 57th GST Council meeting at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi, focusing on dispute resolution and Input Tax Credit (ITC) flow.
A five-pronged plan was proposed covering process reforms, structural reforms, ease of living and doing business, exports of services, and e-commerce.
Key initiatives include automatic invoice matching, reducing paperwork for ITC claims, and easing return filing frequency for small businesses.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Bullet Train Project: Patna Selected Among 5 Proposed Stations
bullets: Bihar is included in the Varanasi-Patna-Siliguri high-speed rail corridor announced in Union Budget 2026-27.
Five districts identified for bullet train stations are Patna, Buxar, Begusarai, Khagaria, and Katihar.
The project will leverage Japanese Shinkansen high-speed rail technology.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Plans ₹1.88 Lakh Crore Energy Investment
bullets: Bihar proposed ₹1,88,383 crore in energy-sector investments covering generation, transmission, distribution, and renewable energy.
The state targets 24 GW of renewable energy and 6.1 GWh of energy storage capacity by 2029-30.
Proposals include a 2,800 MW nuclear power project in Banka and 8,400 MW of pumped storage across four districts.

bihar_news.title: Bihar MSME Policy 2026 Launched to Make Families Self-Reliant
bullets: Bihar launched the MSME Policy 2026 with a target to make one crore families self-reliant through entrepreneurship.
The government plans to develop 45,000 entrepreneurs with an outlay of ₹3,500 crore.
Bihar aims to attract ₹5 lakh crore in industrial investments and provide 20,000 MW of power to industries over five years.

bihar_news.title: Patna High Court Directs Reconsideration of Pay Protection and Pension for Long-Serving Employee
bullets: The Patna High Court directed Bihar's Water Resources Department to reconsider the service, pay protection, and pensionary claims of a daily-wage employee who worked continuously since 1980.
The petitioner was regularized as a Lower Division Clerk in 2012, but his absorption was treated as a fresh appointment, reducing his basic pay from Rs. 9,840 to Rs. 7,730.
The Court instructed the competent authority to examine the claims under Rule 78 of the Bihar Service Code and the Bihar Pension Rules, 1950, within three months.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Directs Officials to Expedite 'Seva Sankalp, Kayakalp' Campaign
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister directed departments to expedite the 'Seva Sankalp and Kayakalp Abhiyan' to ensure time-bound completion of public infrastructure projects without compromising quality.
The campaign focuses on improving basic facilities in schools, healthcare institutions (primary and sub-divisional health centers), Anganwadi centers, and public utilities.
Key directives included ensuring clean drinking water, electricity, and boundary walls in schools, along with the repair of streetlights, tubewells, and bus stand beautification.
